the_finding: ⛔ THE NEXT UNREAD SURFACE WAS NOT A QUANTITY, AND THAT IS WHY THREE CENSUSES MISSED IT. `_CENSUS` and `_CENSUS_STATS` enumerate notations of NUMBER; an identifier is not a number this synthesis computes. `lint_citations.py` does read every identifier in the repository — for PROVENANCE, i.e. whether it also appears in a tracked JSON. ★ MEASURED, NOT ARGUED, ON THIS MANUSCRIPT'S FIVE NOT-POOLED IDENTIFIERS: PMID 31579002 is anchored in 1 tracked json, PMID 37057757 in 5, doi:10.1186/s13018-025-06245-6 in 7, doi:10.12998/wjcc.v10.i13.4301 in 4 — so provenance is green whichever study they are printed beside. Between the two there was NO instrument on the surface that tells two papers apart, and Appendix A records this document's own instance of the defect: a cohort attributed to a 'Warmke/Antonescu-type series' while linking Huang's PMID, with the row warning that the correction must not be applied by pattern because Warmke LM has a real and DIFFERENT TAF15::NR4A3 paper.

⛔_what_did_not_move: THE COVERAGE NUMBER, BY EXACTLY NOTHING, AND THE REASON IS THE SECOND FINDING RATHER THAN AN EXCUSE. `claim_coverage.py` reads 57 of 271 sentences before and after. Its selectivity filter discards any harvested pattern matching more than 10 % of a document's sentences; the identifier pattern matches 28 against a ceiling of 27. ONE SENTENCE. So an entire notation went from unread to guarded and the committed census says nothing changed — AUT-COV-001 seen from the far side of CYC-0013's finding: there a guard reported full coverage over 35 unread figures, here a guard reads a whole notation and is credited with zero. ⛔ MAX_MATCH_SHARE WAS NOT RAISED TO 0.11. ⛔_a_defect_this_cycle_nearly_shipped: `claim_coverage.py` credits a test module's literals to any document whose BASENAME appears anywhere in that module, comments included. A DECLARED_IDENTIFIERS_NOT_POOLED row here first cited the NR4A3 degrader manuscript by filename, and that one path made that paper read 85 of 964 sentences covered instead of 3 — 82 sentences of false coverage from a guard that opens none of it. ⚠ IT WAS CAUGHT BY REGENERATING claim-coverage.json BEFORE COMMITTING, NOT BY READING THE DIFF, and no gate would have caught it.
